corrections.name: Defense Maritime Solutions Chesapeake Manufacturing Facility

before.current_activity: DMS announced an August 2026 investment of more than $30 million to expand domestic marine-engine manufacturing and testing at its Chesapeake operation.
before.overview: Defense Maritime Solutions operates a marine manufacturing, repair, assembly, and systems-integration facility in Chesapeake. A 2026 expansion adds domestic production and testing capacity for Wartsila medium-speed marine engines.
before.short_description: Chesapeake manufacturing and assembly facility producing marine engines, propulsors, and integrated shipboard systems for U.S. government fleets.

after.current_activity: The August 12, 2026 state announcement describes a planned investment of more than $30 million in expanded Chesapeake marine-engine manufacturing and testing. Completion and commissioning of that additional capacity have not been confirmed.
after.overview: Defense Maritime Solutions operates a marine repair, assembly and systems-integration facility in Chesapeake. Its public company history describes propeller and thruster work and equipment assembly and testing. An August 2026 announcement proposes expanded domestic manufacturing and testing of Wartsila medium-speed marine engines; it does not establish that the new engine-production capacity is already operational.
after.short_description: Chesapeake marine repair, assembly and systems-integration facility, with a separately announced engine-manufacturing expansion.

corrections.reason: Separate the operating facility from the announced expansion. Replace the missing VEDP release with the corresponding official state announcement; require editorial review of the revised availability claims.
